01 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

A STEM mind.
An artist’s heart.

I’m Dariya Kaiym, a student in the STEM Magnet at Montgomery Blair High School.

I love finding different ways to create. I’m part of my school’s FRC robotics club, I make coding projects, and I do art. This space brings those parts of me together.
